summary: Sanofi filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 earnings press release dated October 30, 2026. Net sales rose 14.3% at CER to €14.4B, business EPS grew 19.6% at CER to €3.55, and FY2026 guidance was upgraded to low-teens sales growth and mid-teens business EPS growth. Management cited expanding the Regeneron alliance and a legacy-medicine partnership with Cheplapharm, but disclosed no transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor. This is a routine quarterly results filing, not a special situation; watch pipeline, Dupixent LOE strategy, and M&A commentary.
